target_customer: Originally restaurants, later direct to consumers and diners buying salads grown on site
problem: Greens lose flavor and nutrition in long supply chains; the company grows produce at or next to the point of sale so food is harvested the same day.
business_model: Started as indoor farm technology for restaurants, shifted in the pandemic to direct to consumer produce delivery, then to company owned drive thru salad restaurants
product_category: Indoor vertical farming and farm to table quick service restaurants

founders.name: Clayton Mooney
founders.background_notes: Per Cultivation Corridor profile: former professional poker player in Ireland, took part in Iowa State University startup programs. Degree not stated there. The YC page lists no founders.

founders.name: Danen Pool
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the Cultivation Corridor profile; CTO per a search snippet. Background not described.

competitors.name: Infarm
competitors.what: Berlin modular indoor farms placed in grocery stores and restaurants
competitors.funding_then: a 25 million raise per the headline of an ImpactAlpha article; date not shown in the search result

technical_complexity.rationale: Vertical farming systems with automation and robotics for a two person team; crop growing, light and nutrient control are known but hard to run economically.

defensibility.rationale: Vertical farming equipment and hydroponics were available from many vendors; the later differentiator is the consumer brand and same day harvest at restaurants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed the model in sources found; the company changed its own business model instead.

market_need_then: Growing interest in local, fresh produce and indoor farming; the company claims 50 percent more nutrition and flavor from same day harvest, which is a marketing claim.

branding.name_origin: Nebullam was the original company name; Clayton Farms (2022) honors chief farmer and cofounder Clayton Mooney as the public face, per search coverage; the Nebullam origin is not found.
branding.domain_note: Uses ClaytonFarms.com; acquisition details not found

identity.voice_and_tone: Fresh, farm to fork messaging; every meal starts in our on-site fields

branding.brand_signature: A farm about 15 feet from the drive thru kitchen

rebrands.why: Tie the brand to the farm and its public-facing founder, and focus on a consumer brand after the move from business to consumer, per search coverage

branding.community_and_virality: Local and trade press coverage (Iowa State Daily, Agriculture.com, Vertical Farm Daily, Star Tribune), a rewards program and mobile app per the site

brand_strength.rationale: A simple, memorable consumer name and drive thru concept with steady regional press, but small scale with two locations.

pivots.from: Business to business technology and farms placed in restaurants
pivots.to: Direct to consumer produce delivery, a pandemic era pivot per search coverage
pivots.why: Pandemic; pivot date approximate from the search summary

pivots.to: Drive thru salad restaurant in Ames with on site farm
pivots.why: Own the consumer experience and serve greens harvested minutes earlier

outcome_analysis: Nebullam began putting farms inside restaurants, pivoted to direct to consumer produce, rebranded as Clayton Farms in 2022 and opened a drive thru salad restaurant in Ames in March 2023, with a San Francisco site listed on the company page. It raised small amounts, mainly from Ag Startup Engine, and survives as a small operator. Pivoting to a consumer brand and capital efficiency kept it alive; scale and profit are not public.
notes: Funding conflicts: CB Insights lists 160K over four rounds including a Pappajohn competition award; GetLatka says bootstrapped; a Business Record snippet says more than 400K in two rounds with Ag Startup Engine and a near 1 million third round sought. These are unverified and amounts are not recorded as rounds. Competitor entries have no confirmed dates (search snippets only), which is a weakness: no source dated near the batch was verified for competitors. Founding year varies 2016 to 2017. 2025 outcome search found nothing about closure.
